integrity.computation_role: finite corroboration; proof covers arbitrary finite complexes
integrity.evidence_type: explicit combinatorial construction and integral Smith calculation

scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty target simplicial complexes only; a binary but not chip-minimal rooted directed tree is constructed.
The sink is excluded from the firing sets and all unstable nonsink vertices fire simultaneously.
Full arbitrary homotopy types and facet-ordered filtration are realized; no minimality or stochastic robustness is asserted.
title: Universal finite homotopy types and facet-order persistence of avalanche complexes on rooted directed trees
